own.body:
First public beta release.

### Added
- **Register with fairregister** action in the Files app three-dots
  menu (stamper icon). One click hands the selected file off to the
  configured fairregister frontend.
- Single-use download tokens minted server-side (5 min TTL, atomic
  single-use via the distributed cache, brute-force protection
  action `fairregister_download`). The frontend pulls the file once
  via a public `/dl/{token}` endpoint and the token is invalidated.
  No public share link, no plugin-side OAuth, no local DB tables.
- Sidebar navigation entry linking to **My works** on the configured
  fairregister frontend.
- Admin settings with Quick presets (Production / Development) — the
  only required configuration is one click. CORS is limited to the
  configured frontend origin.
